name: opening_drive_reversal_001
mechanism: On NIFTY, the post-auction first 25-35 minutes produce a sharp directional burst of 30-80 spot points as gap-fill program trades, institutional TWAP launches, and retail market orders hit a book that was thinly pre-positioned overnight. When this opening drive stalls — signaled by price reaching 0.3%+ deviation from session VWAP, the 30-second RSI(6) reading entering extreme territory (≤15 or ≥85), and a visible rejection wick consuming ≥35% of the bar range — VWAP-benchmarked institutional algorithms begin counter-flow aggressively since they are getting fills materially better/worse than their session-VWAP benchmark. At 5-second resolution we enter the moment the exhaustion wick forms, capturing the first 10-18 spot point mean-reversion leg within 30-90 seconds.
core_signal_oneliner: Opening drive price 0.3%+ beyond VWAP with RSI(6) at extreme and rejection wick >35% of bar range, with first reversal-direction bar confirming exhaustion within 09:20-10:00
